Hi Liam / Elena —

Thanks again for taking the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we're aligned:

- Deployment modes you asked us to evaluate: Hosted API (per-token), Dedicated (reserved GPU capacity), Private VPC (customer-managed infra).
- Primary concerns you raised: predictable monthly spend for budgeting, data residency/compliance, and ability to burst for trading desk spikes.

Proposed next steps:
1) I'll share a short cost model comparing per-token vs reserved capacity and an example commit profile for Dedicated.
2) Marissa (solutions eng) and Dev (infra) will pick two representative prompt/sequence length examples from your engineers so we can estimate token usage and latency profiles.
3) If the numbers look good, we can schedule a 45-min technical deep dive next week to walk through Dedicated sizing and Private VPC network requirements.

I'll attach a preliminary cost spreadsheet and Redwood Q1 price reference to get the conversation started. Please confirm if we should target USD monthly commit or an annual contract for the Dedicated illustration.

Hi Liam — picking this up from Aditya. See answers + quick assumptions below. I've attached the updated cost model that includes the Dedicated reserved vs burst scenarios and a Hosted per-token estimate.

Assumptions (please confirm):
- Workload: NLG summarization using an LlamaX-16B variant; average input+output = 512 tokens; 10k requests/month baseline, spike to 30k in high month.
- Latency SLO: <300ms p95 target for key routes (trading desk).
- Dedicated config used for modeling: 8x A10G GPUs (reserved) with burst pool to add up to 12 GPUs on peak; baseline utilization 65% for steady-state.

Summary (high-level):
- Hosted API (per-token): ~USD 0.00025 per token (model-dependent). With 512 tokens x 10k reqs = ~1.28M tokens => ~$320/month baseline. Spike to 30k reqs => ~3.84M tokens => ~$960/mo.
- Dedicated (reserved commit): Estimated committed monthly cost for 8x A10G cluster (with Redwood management & ingress/egress) = ~$38k/month. Effective cost per-million-token equivalent depends on utilization; at 65% util and our token profile this maps to ~USD 95–120 per 1M tokens. With burst to 12 GPUs during peaks, incremental hourly burst cost applies.
- Private VPC/on-prem: One-time setup SOW (networking, HSM/KMS integration, baseline infra templates) estimate = USD 45–80k depending on customer's infra. Ongoing monthly run-rate (ops + infra) varies widely; ballpark for similarly sized setups we see USD 20–40k/mo. Redwood supports KMS integrations and can work with HSM options for key custody in Private deployments.

Attachments: updated cost sheet (tabs: assumptions, hosted_calc, dedicated_calc, private_vpc_estimates).

Next steps:
- If these ranges look reasonable, Aditya can put together a committed Dedicated proposal (monthly vs annual commit) and we can model a few commit levels (e.g., 4 GPU, 8 GPU, 12 GPU) to show per-token economics.
- Dev/FinLytics: if you can share a sample day of request volume and a couple of representative prompt sizes, we will refine the model for your exact traffic shape.

Happy to jump on a call tomorrow to walk through the spreadsheet live.

Best,
Marissa Cole
